capabilities: chat with an agent that reads and searches the vault
propose add, modify, or delete file changes for review
organize notes by splitting and moving files into folders
explain concepts grounded in notes, PDFs, and sources
search across the vault, local files, and the web
extras: Local features are free but model access needs a provider subscription or API key. On Windows, or without ripgrep, the grep tool runs with unrestricted filesystem access. The roadmap lists MCP, terminal access, and Anthropic/Grok support as future work, not shipped.
motivation: The author built it to demo an agent SDK: “We are also building an experimental agent sdk… we just chose to demo this idea with Obsidian.”
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI agent that can read the vault, ground answers in its notes, and propose file edits for review.

relations.evidence: OpenAI Plus/Pro subscriptions, OpenCode Go subscriptions via API key, and OpenRouter API keys.
Greater parity with popular coding agents like Claude Code, including:

requires.name: OpenAI Plus/Pro or OpenCode Go subscription

summary: AI agent plugin that reads your vault, chats, searches notes and the web, and proposes reviewable add, modify, and delete changes to your Markdown files.
